message.Title: Generally Available: Dynamic threshold for Log search alerts

Body.Content:
We’re excited to announce the General Availability of Dynamic threshold for Log search alerts! Using dynamic thresholds means you don't have to know the right threshold for each Log alert rule - Dynamic thresholds calculate the most appropriate thresholds for you.

Key benefits
Dynamic thresholds apply advanced machine learning and use a set of algorithms and methods to:
  1. Learn the historical behavior of log query results.
  2. Analyze these results over time and identify hourly / daily / weekly seasonal patterns.
  3. Calculate the most appropriate thresholds for log alert rules.
  4. Adapt automatically to changes in data patterns and adjust the threshold accordingly.
  5. At-scale monitoring - in rule monitoring multiple dimensions - the Dynamic threshold is calculated individually, per dimension combination.
Learn more.
